description: Quick reference formula sheet for Adjectives.

content:
Adjectives — Quick Reference

Key Formulas / Values

Adjective + er for comparative form, Adjective + est for superlative form, more + Adjective for comparative form, most + Adjective for superlative form.

Mnemonics

Big Elephants Attack Little Tigers to remember the order of adjectives (B - Bigger, E - Era/age, A - Adjective, L - Location, T - Type).

Key Points

  • Adjectives describe or tell us more about nouns or pronouns.
  • There are different types of adjectives such as descriptive, quantitative, qualitative, and demonstrative.
  • Adjectives have comparative and superlative forms to compare between two or more things.
  • Some adjectives have irregular comparative and superlative forms.
